roles.description: Software Engineers design, build, and maintain software systems that power applications and services.

2-4.label: Mid

10+.technicalExpectation: Architecture-level coding. Define patterns and standards.

feedbackDimensions.name: Code Correctness

feedbackDimensions.name: Communication
